dedupe_keys.name: un e government development index and its telecommunication infrastructure index tii 193 countries

description: The UN E-Government Development Index (EGDI) is published with the UN E-Government Survey, most recently in 2022 and 2024, for all UN member states. It is the average of three component indices: online services, the Telecommunication Infrastructure Index (TII) and the Human Capital Index. Each component can be extracted and analysed on its own; the components are standardised with a Z-score before averaging, and countries are grouped into very high (0.75 to 1.00), high, middle and low levels. The TII combines telecom indicators from the ITU, such as internet users and mobile and fixed broadband subscriptions per 100 people. The data centre offers country data, regional data and comparisons, including city data from the Local Online Service Index. Coverage: 193 countries, survey editions since 2003, every two years. Format and access: web tables and downloadable country data on the UN DESA site, free; the terms of use of the UN site apply. Caveats: a composite index, so levels depend on normalisation and change with methodology; TII is derived from ITU series, not new measurement. Simulation uses: a comparable national score of telecom infrastructure for cross-country resilience and exposure studies. Related records: data-itu-ict-statistics gives the underlying indicators.
